name: Haven University: A New Friend Starts Here
source:
You are a new student attending Haven University! You're enjoying your time at the school so far, there's just one problem... You don't have any friends!

Luckily for you the school's biggest fraternity is hosting an open-invite party, so the whole school is invited! What better place to meet new people and possibly make some friends?

[From [url=https://samrosemod.itch.io/haven-university]itch.io[/url]]
